issues.label: Applicability of CCP 533 to DVROs
issues.why: The court must decide whether section 533's injunction-dissolution standard applies to DVPA proceedings at all.

issues.label: DVPA statutory framework governs dismissal
issues.why: The DVPA sets specific standards for issuing/denying restraining orders that may displace section 533.

issues.label: Dismissal for failure to complete case
issues.why: Whether dismissing a DVRO petition because trial exceeded the time estimate is a permissible ground.

issues.label: Adequacy of hearing time afforded
issues.why: Court must assess whether it improperly denied a full evidentiary hearing on the merits.

issues.label: Due process right to be heard
issues.why: Wife may have been denied a meaningful opportunity to present her case before dismissal.

issues.label: Court's duty to manage trial time
issues.why: Whether allocating a half-day contrary to the two-day estimate was error or abuse of discretion.

issues.label: Reporter-absence delay attribution
issues.why: Whether penalizing Wife for the court-reporter misunderstanding was proper basis for dismissal.

issues.label: Standard for issuing DVRO on merits
issues.why: Whether past abuse alone suffices and reasonable proof of a past act supports an order.

issues.label: Weight of audio-recording evidence
issues.why: The recording's admitted content directly evidences abuse the court must weigh.

issues.label: Credibility findings requirement
issues.why: Court disclaimed ruling on credibility yet relied on abuse not being credible per Husband.

issues.label: Reliance on Husband's four-question testimony
issues.why: Whether basing dissolution on Husband's promises not to abuse was legally sufficient.

issues.label: 'Future probability of violence' standard misuse
issues.why: DVPA does not require finding future violence to grant a restraining order.

issues.label: Distinction between DVTRO and DVRO
issues.why: Court conflated dissolving the temporary order with dismissing the entire petition.

issues.label: Protection of the minor child
issues.why: Child was a protected party with independent abuse allegations requiring adjudication.

issues.label: Effect of custody orders on dismissal
issues.why: Dismissal impacts existing sole-custody and visitation orders for the child.

issues.label: Immigration-related coercive control
issues.why: Threats of deportation may constitute abuse/coercive control under the DVPA.

issues.label: Financial control as abuse
issues.why: Controlling finances and movement is cognizable coercive control despite Husband's rebuttal evidence.

issues.label: Relevance of unsubstantiated CWS finding
issues.why: CWS's non-substantiation does not preclude a family-court abuse finding.

issues.label: Relevance of no criminal prosecution
issues.why: Absence of prosecution for the April 20 incident is not dispositive of civil abuse.

issues.label: 'Ends of justice' analysis under 533
issues.why: If applicable, court must properly weigh the equities rather than counsel's conduct.

issues.label: Sanctioning conduct against wrong party
issues.why: Penalizing Wife for her counsel's scheduling failures raises fairness concerns.

issues.label: Dismissal without prejudice implications
issues.why: Whether without-prejudice dissolution adequately protects Wife given renewed-petition burdens.

issues.label: Standard of review on appeal
issues.why: Determining abuse-of-discretion versus de novo review shapes the outcome.

issues.label: Cooling-off period as justification
issues.why: Whether the DVTRO's temporary effect justifies denying a permanent order on the merits.
